units.text: 如果您需要撤回（取消）已请求的Board hearing，您或您的代表应在听证会至少2周前，向退伍军人上诉委员会发送书面请求，说明撤回听证会的原因，并包含您的姓名和上诉的VA档案编号。
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context states that to withdraw a hearing request, you or your representative should send a written request at least 2 weeks before the hearing, including your name, VA file number, and reason for withdrawal.

units.text: 您可以将书面请求邮寄或传真至委员会。
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context says you can send the written request by mail or fax to the Board.

units.text: 撤回听证会不会加快您的上诉进度，除非您同时切换到Direct Review选项（仅在特定时间可行）。
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context states that withdrawing the hearing request will not speed up your appeal unless you also switch to the Direct Review option, which is only available at certain times.

units.text: 如果您撤回听证会请求，您仍可以在撤回后90天内提交新证据供法官审核。
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context says you can still submit new evidence within 90 days after withdrawing the hearing request.
